info.title: ScrapingAnt Universal API
info.description: ScrapingAnt is a web scraping API for retrieving web page content through managed browser and proxy infrastructure, with optional rendered HTML, markdown, structured extraction, and API credits usage visibility.

get.description: Retrieves scraped Markdown from a URL in ScrapingAnt.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Fully qualified URL to scrape and convert to Markdown.

schema.description: Fully qualified URL to scrape and convert to Markdown.

parameters.name: browser
parameters.description: Enable ScrapingAnt headless browser rendering. Default is true.

schema.description: Enable ScrapingAnt headless browser rendering. Default is true.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Maximum request runtime in seconds. ScrapingAnt supports 5-60 seconds.

schema.description: Maximum request runtime in seconds. ScrapingAnt supports 5-60 seconds.

parameters.name: returnPageSource
parameters.description: Return server response data unaltered by browser rendering. Works only with browser=true.

schema.description: Return server response data unaltered by browser rendering. Works only with browser=true.

parameters.name: proxyType
parameters.description: Proxy pool type. Supported values are datacenter and residential.

schema.description: Proxy pool type. Supported values are datacenter and residential.

parameters.name: proxyCountry
parameters.description: Two-letter proxy country code, such as US, GB, BR, or DE.

schema.description: Two-letter proxy country code, such as US, GB, BR, or DE.

parameters.name: waitForSelector
parameters.description: CSS selector ScrapingAnt should wait for before returning the result. Requires browser=true.

schema.description: CSS selector ScrapingAnt should wait for before returning the result. Requires browser=true.

parameters.name: blockResource
parameters.description: Resource type to block while rendering, such as image, stylesheet, script, xhr, or fetch.

schema.description: Resource type to block while rendering, such as image, stylesheet, script, xhr, or fetch.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

markdown.description: Markdown content extracted from the page.

url.description: Source URL that was converted to Markdown.
